name: Adjacent
note: Unequal's Adjacent ruleset, which the app deals under Unequal's id. Its clue kind is complete: every edge carries a bar or none, and none says the two are not consecutive.

done.note: a play aid with no meaning for the answer

techniques.note: A placed number leaves its neighbor across an edge only the numbers the edge's clue allows.
techniques.for: k in clues(bar), a in ends(at(k)) where known(a), b = other(at(k), a)
techniques.conclude: forall d in cand(b) where not fits(k, value(a), d): strike(b, d)

techniques.note: A number is struck across an edge when none of the other end's candidates fits it.
techniques.for: k in clues(bar), a in ends(at(k)), b = other(at(k), a)
techniques.conclude: forall d in cand(b) where not (exists d2 in cand(a): d2 != d and fits(k, d2, d)): strike(b, d)
